file.canonicalName: 2026-02-25 - Signed LDFA Carbon Regeneration Grant Resolution.pdf
file.comparison: The supplied PDF is byte-for-byte identical to supplemental record 167. Its two scanned pages contain the LDFA carbon-regeneration grant-support resolution and signed 7-0 adoption certification; they do not contain the HNF-P7H3-DCN87 IPP PFAS Interim Report.
file.verifiedContent: The resolution states that the LDFA oversees the Kysor Superfund groundwater cleanup system, that two 5,000-pound carbon vessels had been repurposed for PFAS capture, that one vessel was no longer effective because of accumulated foulants, and that the board voted 7-0 to support a City NextCycle grant request for onsite carbon regeneration and PFAS destruction.
